user_feedback: Your total spend and department breakdown match the CSV, and you correctly flagged INV-302 and INV-304. However, you misclassified INV-305 (DataVault Backup) as a violation even though it is marked preapproved_exception=yes under the Annual Continuity Waiver in budget_policy.md, which inflated the net non-compliant total from $30,000 to $45,000 and added an unnecessary remediation item for Infrastructure.
